answer: First, a new identity posts 300 tokens. Next, three established nodes in different regions vouch, each locking a 40-token bond. If the identity's first 90 days carry any falsity, its stake burns and every vouching witness gets slashed. Ten thousand sybils therefore need thirty thousand off-network witnesses, burning 1.2 million tokens in bonds they can lose. The plume marks the vent from a distance; the bond makes every fake vertex on the graph legible, and the delta between claim and proof settles against the vouchers.
